Dialogue_Text: "The group could feel the webs slowing them down, but they had to continue. They had to free themselves from the Demonweb Pits. They've been walking through these strange and deadly parts of the Abyss for days now. Finally, they found out that there is a way to escape that appalling place: the magic glyph should be somewhere here, in the cocoon-like lair. The question is: what creature used it as its resting place? Then—the answer appeared in front of them. The eight-legged, grotesque thing was standing there, with a crooked smile on her face."
Nau! This book—it speaks of the Demonweb Pits! The home of the Spider Queen.
If you are truly considering facing whatever horrors are described in this book, better prepare yourself for the words, nirgon, as it will be much worse than you think!
As an adventurer, you must have seen many... unusual places. Would you like to explore that tale? Face the creature? The cost is 3,500 gold pieces.
Yes. I want to face that monster.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Of course. I truly hope you are ready to fight that monstrous fanatic. Now, close your eyes. Let the story take you.
